# Junis

> Junis is an AI orchestration platform for building and managing multi-agent workflows with MCP integration and enterprise integrations.

Junis provides a comprehensive platform for orchestrating generative AI models through multi-agent systems. The documentation covers everything from getting started with the web interface to advanced integrations with external services like Composio, MCP-compatible clients, and enterprise tools.

## Key Topics

- AI Orchestration
- Multi-Agent Workflows
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Composio Integration
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- Agent Memory Systems
- Agent Identity & Personality
- External API Integration
- OAuth Integrations
- Claude Desktop
- AI Agents
- LLM Agents
- Authentication
- Tools & Extensions
- Platform Architecture

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to Junis](https://docs.junis.ai): Junis homepage: orchestrate generative AI models with multi-agent workflows
- [Introduction](https://docs.junis.ai/introduction): Platform introduction covering AI orchestration, MCP integration, and multi-agent workflows
- [Quickstart](https://docs.junis.ai/quickstart): Build your first Junis AI agent in 5 minutes with web interface
- [Core Concepts](https://docs.junis.ai/concepts): Junis platform architecture, multi-agent systems, and core concepts

## API Reference

- [External API Overview](https://docs.junis.ai/api-reference/external-overview): External API overview for integrating Junis AI agents into applications
- [Authentication](https://docs.junis.ai/api-reference/authentication): API key authentication and security for Junis External API requests

## Integration Guides

- [MCP Integration Overview](https://docs.junis.ai/guides/mcp/overview): Model Context Protocol integration guide for connecting agents to external services
- [Composio Integration](https://docs.junis.ai/integrations/composio): Connect 200+ OAuth apps (Gmail, Slack, GitHub) to Junis AI agents
- [Junis Magic](https://docs.junis.ai/guides/junis-magic): Manage Junis platform via Claude Desktop and MCP-compatible clients
- [Tools Overview](https://docs.junis.ai/guides/tools/overview): Extend agents with tools via MCP, Composio, and RAG capabilities

## Agent Configuration

- [Memory System](https://docs.junis.ai/guides/memory-system): Persistent hierarchical memory system for AI agents to learn over time
- [Soul & Identity](https://docs.junis.ai/guides/soul-identity): Configure AI agent personality, brand voice, and communication style

- [AI Consulting Services](https://docs.junis.ai/consulting/overview): AI consulting services for business innovation and organizational transformation
